title: Insight IOC export (insight-ioc-v1)
description: Cross-report indicator export produced by GET /api/iocs/export, the workspace's Export IOCs dialog and `insight export-iocs`. Not STIX. Fields may be added within v1, so consumers should ignore unknown properties; renaming or removing a field would make it v2. See docs/IOC_EXPORT.md.

format.description: Format identifier. Check it before reading the rest of the file.

export_id.description: Unique ID of this export. Also the object_id of the `ioc.export` audit event that recorded it.

generated_at.description: When the file was produced (ISO-8601, UTC).

handling_notice.description: Human-readable handling reminder. Not machine policy.

tlp.description: Most restrictive TLP label among the reports included in this file (AMBER when the file is empty). Handle the whole file at this label.

defanged.description: True if indicator values, report titles and evidence excerpts were defanged. Source URLs never are.

iocs.description: One entry per distinct indicator, sorted by kind, then value.

tlp.description: Traffic Light Protocol 2.0 label, least to most restrictive.

review_status.description: An analyst's verdict on one extracted mention. `accepted` means the extraction is accurate, not that the indicator is malicious.

verdict.description: An analyst's verdict on the indicator: what it means, as opposed to review (whether it was copied correctly). `unknown` when none was recorded, or when its own label is above the export's TLP limit.

flag.description: Why a value is unsafe to block: a private or reserved address, a documentation range, a special-use name, or a vendor domain reports cite constantly. Computed from the value (docs/IOC_EXPORT.md).

triage_status.description: The report's triage state in the inbox (not a verdict on any indicator).

filters.description: The normalised filters that produced the file (defaults filled in).

status.description: Only reports with this triage status (null = any).

tlp.description: Only reports with exactly this label (null = any).

include_superseded.description: Whether superseded revisions of synced items were included.

max_tlp.description: Reports labelled more restrictively than this were left out (null = no limit).

document_ids.description: Only these reports ([] = no limit). Chosen reports are included even if superseded.

include_evidence.description: False if evidence excerpts were left out (every source's `evidence` is then null).

verdicts.description: Only indicators with one of these verdicts (all four = no limit).

exclude_flags.description: Indicators with any of these warning flags were left out ([] = none excluded).

mentions.description: Included mentions (an indicator can be mentioned several times per report).

kev.description: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities context, as imported by the CISA KEV connector.

value.description: Canonical value (refanged, lower-case host names, punycode for international names), or the defanged form when `defanged` is true.

entity_id.description: Insight's ID for this indicator; use it with GET /api/entities/{id} to pivot.

tlp.description: Most restrictive label among this indicator's included sources.

first_ingested_at.description: When the oldest included source was added to Insight (not a publication or sighting date).

last_ingested_at.description: When the newest included source was added to Insight.

review_statuses.description: Number of included mentions per review status.

kev.description: KEV context for CVEs that are in the imported CISA KEV catalogue; otherwise null.

verdict_valid_until.description: When the verdict expires (null: no expiry recorded). Blocklists also apply a default lifetime per kind.

flags.description: Warning flags. A flagged value never appears on a blocklist, whatever its verdict.

sources.description: Every included report that mentions the indicator, oldest first.

document_id.description: Report ID; GET /api/documents/{id} returns the full report.

title.description: As stored, or defanged when `defanged` is true.

source_url.description: Publisher link ('' if none); never defanged.

created_at.description: When the report was added to Insight.

is_current.description: False for a superseded revision (included with include_superseded or document_ids).

extractor_version.description: Extractor that produced this report's observations, e.g. `regex-v2`.

mentions.description: Included mentions of this indicator in this report.

evidence.description: Text around the first included mention (up to 90 characters either side), cut at arbitrary character positions. Defanged when `defanged` is true; null when the export was made without evidence.
